series.name: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)
series.notes: Large commercial string inverter, 10 MPPT / 20 strings, shown by SOFAR at Solar Pakistan 2023 (strong PK relevance). This table is the C&I G4 table; several ID numbers collide with the KTLX-G3P and HYD tables but with different names/solutions - e.g. ID013 is 'ReﬂuxFault / Anti-countercurrent overload' here vs 'RefluxFault / Feed-in limitation function is faulty' on KTLX-G3P, and ID023/ID025/ID026/ID104/ID189/ID191/ID192 exist only here. Never merged.

title.ur: Grid voltage imbalance - teen phase ka farq zyada (ID014)

meaning.en: The three grid phase voltages differ by too much, so the inverter stopped. This code exists only on the G4 C&I table.
meaning.ur: Teen grid phase voltages ka farq bohat zyada hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya. Yeh code sirf G4 C&I table par hai.

causes.en: Single-phase loads too heavily concentrated on one leg of a three-phase supply.
causes.ur: Teen phase supply par single-phase load kisi ek leg par bohat zyada jama ho gaya.

causes.en: One phase conductor with high resistance - a loose or undersized connection.
causes.ur: Kisi ek phase conductor ka resistance zyada - loose ya choti connection.

causes.en: Utility single-phase earth fault on one phase of the feeder.
causes.ur: Feeder ke kisi ek phase par utility ka single-phase earth fault.

solutions.en: Measure all three phase-to-neutral voltages with a true-RMS multimeter; the spread should be inside the grid operator's limit.
solutions.ur: True-RMS multimeter se teen phase-to-neutral voltages check karein; un ka farq grid operator ki limit ke andar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Switch off AC breaker and torque all three phase lugs plus neutral, checking for heat discolouration.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke teenon phase lugs aur neutral ko tighten karein aur garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: If grid balance is correct at the meter but not at the inverter, the fault is in the site's AC cable run.
solutions.ur: Agar meter par balance theek ho magar inverter par nahi, to ghalti site ke AC cable run mein hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: Arc fault shutdown protection - PV wiring mein arcing (ID039)

meaning.en: The AFCI arc-detection function tripped and shut the inverter down because it saw arcing in the PV wiring. Indicates a real loose/arcing connection.
meaning.ur: AFCI arc-detection ne trip karke inverter band kar diya kyunke PV wiring mein arcing dekhi. Iska matlab wahan asal mein loose ya arcing connection hai.

causes.en: Loose, corroded or partially disconnected MC4 connector arcing under load.
causes.ur: Load ke neeche loose, corroded ya adhoora disconnected MC4 connector arc kar raha hai.

causes.en: Cable damaged by UV, heat or rodents, breaking down to earth.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuha se damage hua cable, earth ke saath short kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, and do all connector inspection in the dark with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karein, aur saare connector checks andhere mein insulation tester se karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all MC4 connectors, then reconnect every one firmly and re-seat the combiner fuses; replace any burnt connector.
solutions.ur: Saare MC4 connectors nikaalein, phir har ek ko mazbooti se laga kar combiner fuses dobara baithayein; jala hua connector replace karein.

solutions.en: Torque the string fuses to spec and re-test; never bypass an AFCI trip repeatedly - it means real arcing.
solutions.ur: String fuses ko spec par tighten karein aur dobara test karein; AFCI trip ko baar baar bypass na karein - uska matlab asal arcing hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

meaning.en: Internal self-test of the output relay failed at startup, so the inverter will not connect to the grid. Same number, same meaning as the G3P table - but kept separate per instructions.
meaning.ur: Startup par output relay ka internal self-test fail hua, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi hoga. Yehi number G3P table jaisa hai - phir bhi instructions ke mutabiq alag rakha gaya hai.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay drive circuit or relay detection circuit faulty.
causes.ur: Relay drive circuit ya relay detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then do one clean restart.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karke ek baar saaf restart karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the relay connector is fully seated on the board and re-seat it if loose.
solutions.ur: Power off karke dekhein ke relay connector board par poora baitha hai aur loose ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If it fails self-test on every restart, replace the relay module through a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: Input mode setting error - MPPT mode ghalat (ID044)

meaning.en: The MPPT input mode is wrong for the installed array, so the inverter refuses to run. On the G4 table the same number is spelled 'PvConfigError' (not 'ConfigError').
meaning.ur: MPPT input mode installed array ke mutabiq ghalat hai, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar karta hai. G4 table par yehi number 'PvConfigError' ke naam se likha hai ('ConfigError' nahi).

causes.en: 10-MPPT unit set to independent mode while the design expects parallel MPPT pairing.
causes.ur: 10-MPPT unit independent mode par set hai magar design mein parallel MPPT pairing ka plan hai.

causes.en: Setting lost after safety-parameter import or firmware upgrade.
causes.ur: Safety-parameter import ya firmware upgrade ke baad setting khoj gayi.

solutions.en: Count connected strings per MPPT on site and compare with the wiring drawing before touching the menu.
solutions.ur: Site par har MPPT ki connected strings gino aur menu chhoone se pehle wiring drawing se compare karein.

solutions.en: Set parallel/independent mode to match the actual string allocation, then confirm the LCD input mode line.
solutions.ur: Parallel/independent mode ko actual string allocation ke mutabiq set karein, phir LCD par input mode line confirm karein.

solutions.en: After any firmware upgrade, re-verify input mode and country code from the LCD menu.
solutions.ur: Har firmware upgrade ke baad LCD menu se input mode aur country code dobara verify karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

meaning.en: One or more PV strings are connected backwards. Manual action: connect the PV assembly according to the correct polarity.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada PV strings ulti polarity se jure hain. Manual ka action: PV assembly ko sahi polarity ke mutabiq connect karein.

causes.en: String wired back-to-front at the combiner or the DC input terminals.
causes.ur: Combiner ya DC input terminals par string aage se peechhe wire ki gayi.

causes.en: Installer error on one of 20 inputs - easy to miss on a 10-MPPT unit.
causes.ur: 20 inputs mein se ek par installer ka ghalti - 10-MPPT unit par aam tor par nazar nahi aati.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure each string with a DC multimeter; correct polarity reads positive at PV+.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karke har string DC multimeter se check karein; sahi polarity par PV+ par positive reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect and re-terminate the reversed string with the correct polarity; never swap DC cables live.
solutions.ur: Reversed string ko disconnect karke sahi polarity par dobara terminate karein; DC kabhi live par swap na karein.

solutions.en: After correction, confirm each string's Voc matches the design before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Ghalti theek karne ke baad, dobara current dene se pehle har string ka Voc design se match karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

meaning.en: Heatsink 1 temperature protection tripped. The G4 table numbers radiators individually: ID050-ID055 for radiator 1-6, plus ID057/ID058 ambient, ID059-ID061 module 1-3.
meaning.ur: Heatsink 1 ka temperature protection trip hua. G4 table par radiators alag number hote hain: radiator 1-6 ke liye ID050-ID055, plus ID057/ID058 ambient, ID059-ID061 module 1-3.

causes.en: Heat sink fins blocked by dust, cotton or bird droppings - very common on C&I roof arrays.
causes.ur: Heat sink ke fins dhool, rui ya parindon ke guane se band - C&I roof arrays par bohat aam.

causes.en: Ambient above the unit's limit because of poor clearance between inverters in a row.
causes.ur: Row mein inverters ke darmiyan kam clearance ki wajah se unit ka limit se upar ambient.

solutions.en: Power off, then clean the heat sink with an air blower and soft brush - never water or chemicals.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower aur soft brush se saaf karein - kabhi paani ya chemicals na lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure heatsink surface with an IR thermometer and check the clearance gap to the next unit against the manual's minimum.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se heatsink surface temperature check karein aur agle unit se clearance manual ke minimum se compare karein.

solutions.en: If it trips again with a clean sink, check the fan codes ID169-ID175 and the NTC connector on that heatsink.
solutions.ur: Saaf heatsink ke saath dobara trip ho to fan codes ID169-ID175 aur us heatsink ka NTC connector check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: Ambient temperature 1 protection - mahol bohat garm (ID057)

meaning.en: The ambient temperature sensor tripped its protection, so the inverter shut down. The G4 table has two ambient sensors: ID057 and ID058.
meaning.ur: Ambient temperature sensor ka protection trip hua, is liye inverter band ho gaya. G4 table par do ambient sensors hain: ID057 aur ID058.

causes.en: Ambient above the datasheet limit - common in a Pakistani summer with a hot roof or west-facing wall.
causes.ur: Datasheet limit se upar ambient - garm roof ya purkh wali deewar par Pakistani garmi mein aam.

causes.en: Inverter mounted in an enclosed plant room with no ventilation.
causes.ur: Inverter aise enclosure mein lage hai jahan ventilation nahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the LCD's ambient temperature value and compare it with the datasheet limit.
solutions.ur: LCD par ambient temperature ki value padhein aur datasheet limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Install a shade hood and open up clearance on the shaded wall; keep the unit vertical.
solutions.ur: Shade hood lagayein aur dhal wali deewar par clearance barhayein; unit vertical rakhein.

solutions.en: If the LCD reading is normal but it still trips, check the ambient NTC connector and consider an external shade panel.
solutions.ur: Agar LCD reading theek ho phir bhi trip ho to ambient NTC connector check karein aur external shade panel sochen.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

meaning.en: The power-module temperature protection tripped. The G4 table has module 1-3 as ID059, ID060 and ID061.
meaning.ur: Power module ka temperature protection trip hua. G4 table par module 1-3 ke liye ID059, ID060 aur ID061 hain.

causes.en: Fan failure reducing airflow over the power modules.
causes.ur: Power modules par airflow kam karne wala fan failure.

causes.en: Heavy DC load pushing module temperature over the limit even with fans running.
causes.ur: Fans chal rahe hon ke bawajood DC load itna zyada ke module temperature limit cross kar gaya.

solutions.en: Check the fan codes ID169-ID175 first - a stopped fan is the usual trigger for this code.
solutions.ur: Pehle fan codes ID169-ID175 check karein - ruka hua fan is code ki aam wajah hai.

solutions.en: Clean the heat sink and confirm vertical mounting and adequate clearance per the manual's spacing table.
solutions.ur: Heat sink saaf karein aur manual ke spacing table ke mutabiq vertical mounting aur kaafi clearance confirm karein.

solutions.en: Compare actual DC input against the unit rating; oversizing the array raises module temperature.
solutions.ur: Actual DC input ko unit rating se compare karein; array ka size zyada hona module temperature barhata hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.en: Inverter module temperature difference too large (ID062)
title.ur: Inverter module temperature difference bohat zyada (ID062)

meaning.en: The inverter detected too large a temperature difference between its modules, which usually means a cooling or sensing fault rather than a genuinely hot site.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne modules ke darmiyan temperature difference bohat zyada nikala, jo aksar cooling ya sensing ki ghalti hai, garmi ki sachchi wajah nahi.

causes.en: One heatsink blocked and the adjacent one clear, creating a false differential.
causes.ur: Ek heatsink band aur doosra khula, jis se false differential bana.

causes.en: One NTC sensor drifted, reporting a wrong module temperature.
causes.ur: Ek NTC sensor drift kar gaya, galat module temperature report kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check every heat sink for equal airflow; clean the dusty one.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har heat sink par barabar airflow check karein; ghaas wala saaf karein.

solutions.en: Compare each module NTC reading against its neighbours; a single outlier points to the sensor.
solutions.ur: Har module ka NTC reading padosiyon se compare karein; ek akhla reading sensor ki taraf ishara karti hai.

solutions.en: If all sinks are clean and readings match, have the module NTC harness checked by a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar sab sinks saaf hain aur readings match karein to service centre se module NTC harness check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: Hardware differential over-current - earth leakage pakda (ID104)

meaning.en: The hardware residual/differential current comparator tripped. This code appears only on the G4 table and points to earth leakage or a current transformer problem.
meaning.ur: Hardware residual/differential current comparator trip hua. Yeh code sirf G4 table par hai aur earth leakage ya current transformer ki ghalti ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Real earth leakage in the PV array - moisture ingress or damaged cable.
causes.ur: PV array mein asal earth leakage - moisture andar jaana ya damaged cable.

causes.en: CT or the differential sensing circuit faulty, giving a false trip.
causes.ur: CT ya differential sensing circuit kharab, jis se false trip aaya.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the CT secondary with a multimeter at rest; it should read close to zero amps with PV isolated.
solutions.ur: PV isolate karne ke baad multimeter se CT secondary ka resting reading lein; ye zero amps ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If strings are clean and CT reading is normal, escalate - the differential comparator module needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar strings saaf hain aur CT reading normal hai to aage batayein - differential comparator module ko service chahiye.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

meaning.en: The inverter has throttled its output because internal temperature is high. It is a controlled reduction, not a shutdown.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature zyada hone ki wajah se inverter ne output kam kar diya hai. Ye controlled reduction hai, shutdown nahi.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the unit or a hot plant room.
causes.ur: Unit par direct sunlight ya garm plant room.

causes.en: Heat sink partly blocked, or one fan has failed.
causes.ur: Heat sink aadha band, ya ek fan kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check for direct sun and add a shade hood if the unit is exposed.
solutions.ur: Direct sun check karein aur unit exposed ho to shade hood lagayein.

solutions.en: Power off and clean the heat sink with an air blower; keep the unit vertical and ventilated.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower se saaf karein; unit vertical aur ventilated rakhein.

solutions.en: Confirm fans are spinning; if a fan code ID169-ID175 is active, fix that first.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke fans ghoch rahe hain; agar fan code ID169-ID175 active hai to pehle woh theek karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: USB port fault - USB kaam nahi kar raha (ID145)

meaning.en: The inverter USB port or drive is faulty. Manual action: check the USB port of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka USB port ya drive kharab hai. Manual ka action: inverter ka USB port check karein.

causes.en: USB drive not FAT32 formatted, or a marginal drive connector.
causes.ur: USB drive FAT32 format mein nahi, ya connector wala kharab drive.

causes.en: Firmware file placed outside the required firmware subfolder.
causes.ur: Firmware file gharah folder ke bahar rakhi gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, re-seat the USB port and drive, and inspect for bent pins or debris.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke USB port aur drive ko dobara baithayein aur tange pins ya gaddon ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Reformat the drive as FAT32 and copy the update file into the folder named firmware.
solutions.ur: Drive ko FAT32 mein dobara format karein aur update file firmware naam ke folder mein copy karein.

solutions.en: Keep AC isolated and PV disconnected while updating; never update with power live.
solutions.ur: Update ke dauran AC isolate aur PV disconnect rakhein; live power par kabhi update na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

title.ur: PLC communication lost - inverter aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (ID192)

meaning.en: Power-line carrier communication between inverters was lost, so the master/slave link or the PLC comms wiring is at fault. Manual's listed action is to check the meters wiring.
meaning.ur: Inverters ke aapas power-line carrier communication toot gaya, is liye master/slave link ya PLC comms wiring mein ghalti hai. Manual ka diya hua action: meters wiring check karein.

causes.en: PLC comms wiring loose, or a different modbus address assigned to two units.
causes.ur: PLC comms wiring loose, ya do units ko same modbus address diya gaya.

causes.en: RS485 line too long, unterminated, or sharing a noisy route with the AC bus.
causes.ur: RS485 line bohat lambi, open-ended, ya AC bus ke saath noisy route share kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check PLC/RS485 A and B termination and connector seating at each unit.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har unit par PLC/RS485 A aur B termination aur connector ki seating check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every inverter has a unique modbus address from the LCD SystemInfo menu.
solutions.ur: LCD SystemInfo menu se confirm karein ke har inverter ka modbus address unique hai.

solutions.en: Keep the comms cable away from AC power runs, and re-seat the meter per the manual's wiring check.
solutions.ur: Comms cable ko AC power runs se door rakhein, aur manual ke wiring check ke mutabiq meter dobara baithayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list
